title.value: Stimulus information guides the emergence of behavior-related signals in primary somatosensory cortex during learning
title.justification: The title directly reflects the investigation into how stimulus information affects behavior-related signals during learning.
title.quote: Stimulus information guides the emergence of behavior-related signals in primary somatosensory cortex during learning

extractions.description: The paper investigates how sensory- and behavior-related information emerges and intersects in the primary somatosensory cortex during sensory learning by imaging neuronal activity in mice.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The study focuses on understanding neural mechanisms of learning rather than on climate or ecological sustainable development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Neurons in the primary cortex carry sensory- and behavior-related information, but it remains an open question how this information emerges and intersects together during learning.

primary_category.justification: The study is centered around neuroscience and learning mechanisms rather than climate or ecological sustainable development topics.
primary_category.quote: Neurons in the primary cortex carry sensory- and behavior-related information, but it remains an open question how this information emerges and intersects together during learning.

secondary_categories.justification: The study doesn't address secondary themes of climate or ecological sustainable development.
secondary_categories.quote: We investigated this question by imaging neuronal activity in mouse primary somatosensory cortex before, during, and after learning of an object localization task.

primary_sub_category.justification: The research does not fit into any predefined sub-category for climate or ecological sustainable development as it is focused on neural processes.
primary_sub_category.quote: We investigated this question by imaging neuronal activity in mouse primary somatosensory cortex before, during, and after learning of an object localization task.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: The study does not cover any topics related to climate or ecological sustainable development. Its focus is purely on neuroscience.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: Stimulus information guides the emergence of behavior-related signals in primary somatosensory cortex during learning.

applications.quote: We quantified sensory- and behavior-related information and estimated how much sensory information was used to instruct perceptual choices as learning progressed.
